description: UAV tile oil palm crown detection dataset prepared from Roboflow COCO export doyles-workspace/uva_crown version 1

sources.name: Roboflow UAV Oil Palm Crown Export train
sources.annotations_note: Part of the 3400+ total bbox annotations reported for version 1.

sources.name: Roboflow UAV Oil Palm Crown Export valid
sources.annotations_note: Part of the 3400+ total bbox annotations reported for version 1.

sources.name: Roboflow UAV Oil Palm Crown Export test
sources.annotations_note: Part of the 3400+ total bbox annotations reported for version 1.

label_notes: Single-class crown detection. Source categories are normalized to oil_palm_crown; health/status labels are not part of UAV v1.

split_strategy.constraint: Roboflow version 1 train/valid/test split is preserved; no extra local split is generated.
split_strategy.source_limitation: Mission IDs are still not present in the export metadata.

expected_counts.annotations_note: User-reported as 3400+ bboxes; exact split-level counts are regenerated by prepare_dataset.py.

notes: Raw COCO exports and generated YOLO files are ignored by Git.
The Roboflow API key must not be committed to repository files.
Roboflow-side augmentation has already been applied, so additional training augmentation is disabled for the first baseline.
This dataset is for crown localization only; it does not classify health, disease, growth, maturity, or yield.
Cloud remains responsible for tile offsets, global coordinate reconstruction, NMS, tree confirmation, and tree_code creation.
